exact_target_vm.statement: No exact target VM is established. The target has not booted in any backend, and the blockers are listed in the components above

components.title: CPU T8130
components.question: Can the backend model the T8130 CPU (arm64e, GXF/SPRR)?
components.basis: Identity is verified. The installed backend has no T8130 CPU model

decisions.statement: BuildManifest identity matches iPhone16,2, D84AP, ApChipID 0x8130, build 24A446, 27.0.1
decisions.limitation: Identity only. It does not show that any hardware model is available

decisions.statement: The installed QEMU (11.1.3) was probed with a generic virt machine and the max CPU only; no T8130 CPU model, darwin machine or SEP model was present
decisions.limitation: Recorded in phase 9. Not re-run in this phase, per the static-only constraint

components.title: Memory map
components.question: Is the target's physical memory layout modelled?
components.basis: The AIC window translates through the first /arm-io ranges entry. DRAM and carve-outs are filled in at boot and are not in the static tree

decisions.statement: The first /arm-io ranges entry maps child 0x0 to parent 0x210000000
decisions.limitation: Read with the declared cell widths of the node

decisions.statement: The AIC base translates to 0x2d1000000
decisions.limitation: The arithmetic is established. That iBoot maps the window there is not

components.title: Interrupt controller (AIC, aic,3)
components.question: Can an AIC model for aic,3 be bound to the target's interrupt tree?
components.basis: No model. Register semantics are not known: the kernel reads the offsets from the tree, and aic-iack-offset is named in iBoot but absent from the static tree

decisions.statement: The AIC compatible is aic,3 with 1 interrupt cell(s)
decisions.limitation: One cell is Apple's convention, confirmed by the kernel diagnostic string in the analysis

decisions.statement: The upstream Linux AIC bindings require three or four interrupt cells and do not list aic,3
decisions.limitation: Comparison with the public Linux tree, read only. It does not show what Apple's driver does

decisions.statement: The kernel has an AppleInterruptControllerV3 personality matched to aic,3, and the offset property names
decisions.limitation: Strings only. No function cross-references were computed

components.title: Timer (aic-timebase)
components.question: Is the always-on timer modelled?
components.basis: A node exists at the translated window. Its register semantics and any backend model are unknown

decisions.statement: The aic-timebase node reg address is 0x2d1180000
decisions.limitation: Node presence and address only. No timer behaviour was tested

components.title: Power manager (PMGR, pmgr1,t8130)
components.question: Can the PMGR be modelled, and its power domains bound?
components.basis: The compatible is not in the public Linux bindings, the tree has no per-domain nodes, and the blob layout is not documented

decisions.statement: The PMGR compatible is pmgr1,t8130, with 83 register windows and 39 power-domain names
decisions.limitation: Names are ASCII tokens from the blob. No record layout is assumed

decisions.statement: The kernel has an AppleT8130PMGR personality matched to pmgr1,t8130
decisions.limitation: Strings only

components.title: Display controller (DCP)
components.question: Can the display coprocessor be modelled, and does the backend show a target framebuffer?
components.basis: The DCP firmware is present and unencrypted, but there is no DCP model. The only framebuffer is a generic placeholder

decisions.statement: The DCP firmware component is analysed
decisions.limitation: Firmware for the real coprocessor. Not executed

decisions.statement: The recorded probe screenshot shows the generic QEMU placeholder, not an iOS display
decisions.limitation: Generic machine. Not a target result

components.title: GPU (AGX)
components.question: Can the GPU firmware and device be modelled?
components.basis: GPU firmware is present and unencrypted. The installed backend has no GPU model for the target

decisions.statement: The GFX firmware component is analysed
decisions.limitation: Firmware for the real GPU. Not executed

decisions.statement: The installed QEMU (11.1.3) was probed with a generic virt machine and the max CPU only; no T8130 CPU model, darwin machine or SEP model was present
decisions.limitation: Recorded in phase 9. Not re-run in this phase, per the static-only constraint

components.title: USB controllers
components.question: Are the target USB controllers identified and modelled?
components.basis: Not researched in the static analysis. No USB model is recorded

decisions.statement: No USB controller analysis is recorded for the target
decisions.limitation: Nothing was established

components.title: Storage (ANS, system volume)
components.question: Can the storage coprocessor run, and is a full system volume available?
components.basis: The ANS firmware is analysed but has no model, and the system volume image is not available locally

decisions.statement: The ANS firmware component is analysed
decisions.limitation: Firmware for the real storage coprocessor. Not executed

decisions.statement: The system volume (OS) component is unavailable locally
decisions.limitation: The archive lists it. There is no local copy, and its key service is external

components.title: SEP interface
components.question: Can the Secure Enclave firmware be run or emulated?
components.basis: The SEP firmware is encrypted with a keybag and its keys are not available. No SEP model exists for this target

decisions.statement: The SEP firmware component is encrypted (keys not available)
decisions.limitation: The keys are not in the archive. No decryption was attempted

decisions.statement: The installed QEMU (11.1.3) was probed with a generic virt machine and the max CPU only; no T8130 CPU model, darwin machine or SEP model was present
decisions.limitation: Recorded in phase 9. Not re-run in this phase, per the static-only constraint

components.title: SPTM
components.question: Can the Secure Page Table Monitor run under the backend?
components.basis: The image is analysed, but the backend lacks most of the implementation-defined registers it uses

decisions.statement: The SPTM component is analysed
decisions.limitation: Not executed

decisions.statement: In the A13-based model used by the fork, 98 of 127 SPTM implementation-defined registers are undefined
decisions.limitation: Census of the static image. Lifetime classes are low confidence (indirect calls unresolved)

decisions.statement: The SPTM image is named for T8122 while the device tree is T8130
decisions.limitation: The naming discrepancy is recorded, not resolved

components.title: TXM
components.question: Can the Trusted Execution Monitor run under the backend?
components.basis: The TXM runs under the SPTM, which is itself blocked

decisions.statement: The TXM component is analysed
decisions.limitation: Not executed

decisions.statement: The TXM runs under the SPTM in the handoff order
decisions.limitation: The order is taken from the boot-chain notes. Not observed at run time

components.title: DeviceTree compatibility
components.question: Can the target device tree be loaded by the backend?
components.basis: The tree parses and its identity is correct. The backend cannot load it, and boot-time values are missing

decisions.statement: The root compatible is D84AP, iPhone16,2, AppleARM
decisions.limitation: Static template from the restore archive

decisions.statement: The tree has 379 nodes
decisions.limitation: Node count of the binary payload

components.title: Kernel compatibility
components.question: Can the target kernel boot on the target platform model?
components.basis: No boot has been observed. The kernel configuration token names T8122 while the platform is T8130, and no T8130 platform model exists

decisions.statement: The kernel is a arm64e MH_FILESET image with 264 fileset entries
decisions.limitation: Header and load commands only

decisions.statement: The kernel build reports xnu-13432.2.10~2 with configuration RELEASE_ARM64_T8122
decisions.limitation: The T8122 token against the T8130 platform is unresolved

components.title: Root filesystem availability
components.question: Is a root filesystem available for the target?
components.basis: The restore ramdisk is present and unencrypted. The system volume is not available locally

decisions.statement: The restore ramdisk is analysed
decisions.limitation: A restore environment, not the installed system

decisions.statement: The system volume (OS) component is unavailable locally
decisions.limitation: Its key service is external. No decryption was attempted

components.title: GUI feasibility
components.question: Can the target display an interface in the backend?
components.basis: No boot has been observed. The display, the GPU and the kernel are each blocked

decisions.statement: No target boot or display output has been observed
decisions.limitation: The probes used a generic machine and are not target boots
